lesson: artifact.inspect performs static inspection only and never executes a file. It always returns path, bytes, sha256, format and untrusted. Format is identified from magic bytes: elf, pe, mach-o, zip, png, gzip, pdf, wasm. For elf it adds header fields and neededLibraries from DT_NEEDED. For pe it adds machine, sectionCount, timestamp, entryPoint and imports from the import table. For mach-o it adds cpuType, fileType, dylibs, uuid and segments. For zip it lists central-directory entries with name and sizes without extracting. For wasm it lists section ids and sizes. It cannot disassemble, decompile, or run anything, and parsing is bounded so a crafted file degrades to a partial result.
